imageAlt: A yogurt-price increase pivots the budget line inward around the cereal intercept.
graphDescription: The dashed original line has intercepts 10 yogurts and 5 cereal boxes. The solid new line has intercepts 5 yogurts and 5 cereal boxes, consistent with yogurt's price rising from $4 to $8 while income and cereal's price remain fixed.

imageAlt: An income decrease shifts the yogurt-cereal budget line inward in parallel.
graphDescription: The original line has intercepts 10 yogurts and 5 cereal boxes; the new parallel line has intercepts 8 yogurts and 4 cereal boxes. With prices unchanged, income falls from $40 to $32.

imageAlt: A cereal-price decrease pivots the budget line outward around the yogurt intercept.
graphDescription: The dashed original line has intercepts 10 yogurts and 5 cereal boxes. The solid new line has intercepts 10 yogurts and 10 cereal boxes, consistent with cereal's price falling from $8 to $4 while income and yogurt's price remain fixed.

imageAlt: An income decrease shifts the yogurt-cereal budget line inward in parallel.
graphDescription: The original line has intercepts 10 yogurts and 5 cereal boxes; the new parallel line has intercepts 8 yogurts and 4 cereal boxes. With prices unchanged, income falls from $40 to $32.

imageAlt: Nursing labor demand and supply both shift right, increasing equilibrium employment from 4,000 to 8,000 while the wage remains $20.
graphDescription: The vertical axis is hourly wage in dollars and the horizontal axis is hundreds of nurses. Dashed D L0 and S L0 intersect at 4,000 nurses and $20 per hour. Solid D L1 and S L1 intersect at 8,000 nurses and the same $20 wage. In this particular simultaneous-shift case, employment doubles while the equilibrium wage is unchanged.

imageAlt: Graph of disposable vapes consumed (thousands) with labeled marginal curves, intersection guides and a purple bracket.
graphDescription: The horizontal axis measures disposable vapes consumed (thousands), from 0 to 240. The vertical axis measures marginal benefit and cost in dollars per vape. MPB is a straight line from (0, $19) to (240, $7). MPC is a straight line from (0, $1) to (240, $13). MSB is a straight line from (0, $15) to (240, $3), parallel to MPB. A dashed purple line labeled Policy-adjusted MPB runs from (0, $17) to (240, $5), parallel to MPB and MSB. It intersects MPC at a purple dot (160, $9). A red dot marks the MPB-MPC intersection (180, $10), and a green dot marks the MSB-MPC intersection (140, $8). Dashed guides show their coordinates. A purple vertical bracket near Q = 160 spans $9 to $11 on MPB.
